profile.privacySubtitle: Control how MeriBaari uses your data
profile.privacyPolicyBody: MeriBaari stores your account details and ticket history to help you manage queues. We do not sell personal data.
profile.privacyBusinessBody: A business becomes visible to customers only after an administrator approves the subscription payment. The owner cannot submit another subscription payment until 31 days after that approval. Administrators may hide a business from customers if there are complaints, bad reviews, or behaviour issues. Hiding a business does not cancel the paid subscription period. Owners can contact support to request a review.
profile.privacyAnalyticsBody: Help improve wait-time estimates with aggregated usage data.

signup.title: Business visibility
signup.body: Your business profile can be created for free. However, your business will only become visible to customers after your subscription payment has been approved. After approval you may submit the next payment only after 31 days. MeriBaari administrators may hide a business from customers if there are complaints, bad reviews, or conduct issues.

welcome.title: Congratulations 🎉
welcome.body: Congratulations on joining the MeriBaari journey! To become a part of our family and make your business visible to customers, please activate your MeriBaari subscription.

status.hiddenBody: Don't worry — you can subscribe whenever you're ready. Your business profile is saved safely, but your services will not be visible to customers until your subscription is approved.
status.pendingBody: Your payment is being reviewed. Verification usually takes 2–3 hours.
status.rejectedBody: Your payment needs attention. Please review the reason and submit proof again.
status.activeTitle: 🎉 Your business is live on MeriBaari
status.activeBody: Your business is visible to customers.
status.activeHiddenBody: Your subscription is active, but your business is currently hidden from customers. Set it to active in organization settings to appear in search.
status.adminHiddenBody: An administrator has hidden your business from customers due to complaints, reviews, or conduct issues. Your subscription remains active. Contact support if you believe this is a mistake.
status.cooldownBody: You can submit the next subscription payment 31 days after the last admin approval. Next eligible date: {{date}}.
status.policyCooldown: After an administrator approves a payment, you cannot pay another subscription fee until 31 days after that approval.
status.policyVisibility: MeriBaari administrators may hide or restore your business visibility if there are complaints, bad reviews, or behaviour issues. Hiding a business does not refund a paid period.

payment.title: MeriBaari Subscription
payment.subtitle: Monthly subscription · manual payment
payment.intro: Pay the monthly subscription using bank transfer or Easypaisa, then upload a screenshot of your receipt. Our team will review it and make your business visible to customers. After approval, the next payment can be submitted only after 31 days.
payment.uploadNote: After making your payment, upload a clear screenshot of your payment receipt below.
payment.verificationNote: Payment verification usually takes 2–3 hours. Please allow our team some time to verify your payment. You will receive a notification once your payment has been approved.
payment.screenshotHint: Choose a clear photo of your transfer receipt.

submitted.title: Payment Submitted Successfully
submitted.body: Your payment proof has been submitted successfully. Our team will review it within approximately 2–3 hours. You will receive a notification once your payment has been approved.
